narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack down · EMA spread -3.69 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 330.91-334.33 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip) — the trigger is still pending. Risk is defined beyond 354.95; the first objective pays 1.34R at 325.35.

plan.triggerRule: await bearish footprint confirmation (absorption / strong divergence / trap) or wall+CVD confluence at 330.91-334.33
plan.invalidation: structure beyond 354.95 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)
vetoes: M1 R 1.34 < 1.5 — reward does not pay the risk

athena_oracle.verdict: Cautious bearish lean 30/100 — trend broken, liq magnets below
